_readme: Where Decks Find You (/shops/). To add a shop, add one entry to "shops" with the same fields, then run: python3 scripts/build_shops.py. Region must match a name in "regions". Leave website as "" when there isn't one. Shops are sorted by town inside each region automatically.

regions.name: Northern Territory
regions.note: We're still looking for a shop in Alice Springs.

shops.name: Crow and Cauldron
shops.description: A witch shop in Sydney's south, run by Violet, with a warm community feel.
